note: Decimated GLBs plus BodyParts3D atlas chunks. Lead uploads to R2 under the Kardia asset base used by kardia-sim-geom.js; never overwrite a hashed key; code verifies sha256 before use.

assets.attribution: HuBMAP Human Reference Atlas, Visible Human male skin (CCF v1.2), CC BY 4.0, https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library
assets.processing: Decimated 185314 to 25858 triangles by vertex clustering; source 5931700 bytes

registration.sourceUnit: metre (HuBMAP GLB) or atlas mm chunk (BodyParts3D)
registration.patientFrame: x to patient left, y anterior, z cranial, mm, origin at LV cavity centroid
registration.axisMap: patient = [sourceX, sourceZ, sourceY] for HuBMAP GLB (GLB y is cranial); atlas chunks use the kardia-sim-geom.js atlas mapping
registration.recentre: subtract HuBMAP heart bounds centre (0.0187, 0.4761, 0.0376) m before scaling, so heart, skin and liver share the LV origin; skin and liver keep their source offset relative to that centre
